name: FloQast
description: FloQast is a cloud accounting automation platform for corporate accounting and finance teams, built around the financial close process. Positioned as "Built by accountants for accountants," it spans close management (Optimize the Close), reconciliation and journal-entry automation (Automate the Close), audit-evidence collection and risk/control testing (Connected Compliance), and variance analysis/consolidation (Integrated Record-to-Report), with AI Agents that FloQast says require human approval before anything posts to the books.
best_for: Corporate accounting and finance teams — controllers, accountants, and auditors — that want to standardize and automate the month-end close, account reconciliation, and audit-evidence collection on top of their existing ERP rather than replace it.
features: Optimize the Close: global month-end close management, checklists, and accounting-operations tracking
Automate the Close: reconciliation matching, transaction mapping, and journal entry automation
Connected Compliance: evidence collection, risk management, and AI-assisted control testing for audits
Integrated Record-to-Report: variance analysis and consolidation
AI Agents for routine accounting tasks, which FloQast states require human approval before anything is posted ("Nothing hits your books without human approval. No exceptions.")
Native integrations with ERPs including NetSuite, SAP, Workday, and Oracle
FloQademy training and the FloQast Certified Accountant (FCA) credential for accounting teams
pros: FloQast reports being used by 3,500+ global companies
Pricing is described as scaling with business outcomes rather than seat count — FloQast advertises "No Per-User Fees"
ISO 42001-certified for AI management and states on its security page that it has obtained a SOC 3 report
cons: No published pricing — every named package (Close Optimization, Close Automation, Connected Compliance, Compliance Pro, FloQast Reporting, FloQast Transform) routes to a "Contact Sales" quote rather than a self-serve price
No free trial is advertised on FloQast's pricing page

alternatives.name: NetSuite
alternatives.description: Oracle's cloud ERP system unifying accounting, inventory, and order management with multi-subsidiary financial consolidation.
alternatives.best_for: Companies that would rather rely on close and reconciliation capabilities built into their core ERP than add a dedicated close-management layer on top.
strengths: Financial consolidation built into the core ERP
One vendor for financials plus close reporting

alternatives.name: Sage Intacct
alternatives.description: A cloud financial management platform focused on core financials, multi-entity consolidation, and dimensional reporting for mid-market companies and nonprofits.
alternatives.best_for: Mid-market finance teams that want multi-entity consolidation and dimensional reporting native to their accounting system rather than a separate close-automation product.

alternatives.name: Odoo
alternatives.description: An open-source, modular business platform covering accounting, inventory, manufacturing, and more as individually priced apps.
alternatives.best_for: Smaller businesses that want basic close and accounting workflows bundled into a low-cost, published-pricing platform rather than a dedicated close-management product.
strengths: Accounting app bundled with the rest of the suite
